tweets.text: Sleeping during the day after a night shift? A curtain that blocks 90% of light still isn't dark enough for your brain to fully switch off. The gap between "pretty dark" and "actually dark" matters more than most bedrooms are built for.

Blackout curtains vs. a contoured sleep mask, the honest tradeoffs:
🪩 Curtains — fix the whole room, but light leaks at the edges/rod
😴 Contoured mask — fully portable, seals around the eyes, no drilling needed
💰 $25–$60 per window vs $13–$35 for a mask
Most day sleepers end up needing both.

Before: closing the curtains and still lying there at 9am with your brain half-convinced it's daytime (because it is).
After: curtains for the room + a contoured mask for the gaps curtains can't cover. Two cheap fixes beat one expensive one.
